About.metaDescription: Arabya is a free word-by-word Quran study platform: mushaf, iʿrāb, roots, tafsirs, translations, and Studio — with attributed sources.
About.kicker: An Arabic platform for Quran study
About.title: About Arabya
About.lead: Arabya is a platform for studying the Quranic text word by word: grammar, morphology, lexicon, semantics, translation, and tafsir — with clear attribution for every data layer. Published at www.arabya.org.
About.freeNote: Everything on Arabya is free for everyone — open access to the mushaf, study tools, and Studio.

pillars.title: What we offer
pillars.intro: We focus on understanding each word in context — not only flipping pages.
pillars.p0: Every mushaf word can be studied: iʿrāb, root, meaning, translation, and tafsir when sources are available.
pillars.p1: Every data layer is shown with its source — we do not mix opinions without labeling them.
pillars.p2: An Arabic (RTL) interface from the index to the mushaf to daily study tools.
pillars.p3: Reading, study, and Studio creation are available without fees.

features.title: What you find today
features.r0: <indexLink>Surah index</indexLink> with search in ayah text and roots, favorites, and last-read tracking.
features.r1: <mushafLink>Madinah mushaf</mushafLink> (pages 1–604) with word-by-word display, font scaling, sharing, and light/dark mode.
features.r2: <juzLink>Thirty juz index</juzLink> and surah reading with study and iʿrāb links.
features.r3: Ayah and word recitation with reciter choice and ayah repeat where available.
features.s0: Word study dock: iʿrāb · lexicon, morphology & root · translation & semantics · tafsir.
features.s2: <studyLink>Quick study</studyLink> and a <rootsLink>roots index</rootsLink> with every occurrence in the Quran.
features.t0: <asmaLink>The Beautiful Names</asmaLink>, prayer times and qibla, and daily reading habit on the home page.
features.t1: <studioLink>Arabya Studio</studioLink> to create ayah images and videos with backgrounds and export.
features.t2: <booksLink>Iʿrāb books</booksLink> and <resourcesLink>resources</resourcesLink> — updated when licensed sources are available.

sources.title: Data sources
sources.intro: We rely on open or licensed sources with attribution:
sources.qurancom: <qLink>Quran.com</qLink> — QPC Hafṣ text, ayah translations, word-by-word glosses, and tafsirs used in the UI.
sources.corpus: <cLink>Quranic Arabic Corpus</cLink> — organized morphology, iʿrāb, and roots (GPL with attribution).
sources.lemma: Local Arabic lemma senses for Arabya (lemma-sense-ar) for short study glosses.
sources.asmaData: Beautiful Names content and attributed meanings in project data.
sources.gitFirst: Static Quran content is managed Git-first so it stays transparent and traceable.

next.title: What we are working on
next.intro: We deepen Quran word layers in the UI before expanding other hubs.
next.n0: Richer semantics and rhetoric layers when attributed sources are available.
next.n1: Classic iʿrāb books and dictionaries after written licensing from rights holders.
next.n2: Later hubs (such as hadith and heritage) after the Quran word foundation is solid in the UI.

Terms.metaDescription: Arabya terms: permitted use, no commercial cloning or bulk scraping, and copyright on original content.
Terms.title: Terms of use
Terms.lead: By using <brand>Arabya</brand> (arabya.org / arabyaai.com) you agree to these terms. Reading and study are open to everyone; the code, UI, and derived datasets remain protected by <brand>Arabya</brand>.

summary.title: Summary
summary.s0: Personal reading and study are welcome.
summary.s1: Copying the site or extracting its data for commercial republication or a clone competitor is not allowed.
summary.s2: Large-scale automated scraping or overloading our servers is not allowed.
summary.s3: Original content and the UI are © <brand>Arabya platform</brand> unless stated otherwise.

use.title: Permitted use
use.p0: You may browse the mushaf, study words, listen to recitation, and use Studio and smart recitation (where login is required) for personal and educational purposes.
use.p1: You may not use the service for unlawful activity, attempting to break into systems, or impersonating the platform.

prohibited.title: Prohibited
prohibited.p0: Copying the site design, code, or derived datasets in whole or in part to launch a competing site or commercial product without written permission.
prohibited.p1: Extracting data (API scraping, bulk download, mirrors) beyond normal visitor use.
prohibited.p2: Removing branding, copyright notices, or source attribution from content or exports (e.g. Studio images).
prohibited.p3: Training models on or selling datasets built from platform content without permission.

ownership.title: Intellectual property
ownership.o0: The UI, UX, original Arabic copy, logo, and derived datasets produced by <brand>Arabya</brand> are protected by copyright.
ownership.o1: © 2026 <brand>Arabya platform</brand>. All rights reserved in original content and software.
ownership.o2: The names «Arabya» / «عربية» and associated branding are part of the platform identity.

sources.title: Third-party sources
sources.q0: The Quranic text itself is not commercial property — it is the word of Allah.
sources.q1: Tafsirs, translations, and iʿrāb come from open or licensed sources; we follow each license (e.g. Quranic Arabic Corpus GPL attribution where applicable).
sources.q2: Your use of third-party licensed content is also subject to that party's terms.

enforcement.title: Enforcement
enforcement.p0: We may restrict access, suspend accounts, or take legal action for violations. For questions or licensing: <contactLink>Contact us</contactLink> or <emailLink>contact@arabya.org</emailLink>.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p0: We may update this page. The “Last updated” date above reflects the current version. See also <privacyLink>Privacy</privacyLink> and <aboutLink>About Arabya</aboutLink>.

Privacy.metaDescription: How Arabya protects your privacy: browse without an account, optional sync, and what stays local or in the cloud.
Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: Arabya respects your privacy. You can read the mushaf and study without an account. Google sign-in is optional to sync your data across devices. We do not sell personal data. Everything on Arabya is free for everyone.

summary.title: Quick summary
summary.s0: No sign-in is required to read, study, or use Studio.
summary.s1: Without an account: favorites, notes, and reading habit stay on your device only.
summary.s2: With a Google account: that data may sync to the server tied to your account.
summary.s3: Everything on Arabya is free for everyone.
summary.s4: Aggregated usage stats may be recorded (no ad tracking).

accounts.title: Optional account (Google)
accounts.p0: When you sign in we typically receive name, email, and profile photo to show your account and manage the session — not for advertising.
accounts.p1: The session uses technical cookies (Auth.js). You can sign out anytime from <accountLink>My account</accountLink>.

sync.title: Account sync
sync.p0: When sync is enabled for a signed-in account, a copy is stored of:
sync.i0: Favorites and last mushaf page / reading progress.
sync.p1: Purpose: restore your data on another device after sign-in. Visitors without an account do not upload personal data.

local.title: What stays on your device
local.p0: A local copy for speed, plus UI settings (appearance, font size, gloss language, translation, reciter…). You can clear site data from browser settings.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p0: We use cookies required for the session after sign-in, plus local storage for preferences. We do not use third-party ad trackers across sites.

rights.title: Your rights & choices
rights.r0: Browse and study without an account.
rights.r1: Sign out and clear local storage from the browser.
rights.r2: Request inquiry or deletion of account data via <contactLink>Contact us</contactLink> or <emailLink>contact@arabya.org</emailLink>.

changes.title: Policy changes
changes.p0: We update this page when major features change. The Last updated date above reflects the current version. For more: <aboutLink>About Arabya</aboutLink>.

StudioAi.metaDescription: Generate a short video from a topic with AI, beside ayah Studio
StudioAi.title: AI video from a topic
StudioAi.lead: Give a topic; the engine writes a script, synthesizes speech, fetches stock clips, and renders HD video. Ayah recitation Studio stays on its own pages.
StudioAi.engineOnLead: The FastAPI service is accepting jobs.
StudioAi.engineOffLead: Start services/money-printer-turbo or docker-compose.mpt.yml and check MONEYPRINTER_API_URL.
StudioAi.engineUnconfiguredLead: Add MONEYPRINTER_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080 to your env file and restart Arabya.
StudioAi.engineLoginLead: AI video is ready inside your account. Sign in with Google, then tap Create video.
StudioAi.diffLead: This path is topic + AI + stock footage fetched via API. Recitation videos are created at /studio/projects/new.
StudioAi.flow2: AI writes the script and fetches clips from the Pexels API
StudioAi.flow3: Voice, captions, then a server-side render
StudioAi.createLead: Enter a topic. The engine writes the script, synthesizes speech, and fetches clips from the internet via the Pexels API — no local folder picker.
StudioAi.subject: Topic
StudioAi.subjectPlaceholder: Example: How small daily habits compound over time
StudioAi.scriptPlaceholder: Leave empty for the AI to write it, or paste your own text.
StudioAi.termsPlaceholder: Generated automatically if empty — example: charity, nature, city morning
StudioAi.sourceLead: Clips are fetched automatically through a stock-video API. The engine folder of local files is not used.
StudioAi.noBgm: No background music (recommended until song files are added)
StudioAi.errorScript: Could not generate a script. Check the engine and LLM key.
StudioAi.errorVideo: Could not create the job. Check engine status and keys.
StudioAi.errorLlmBlocked: The AI service (LLM) is currently unavailable. Try again shortly or write the script manually.
StudioAi.errorEngineOff: The video engine is not configured on the server.
StudioAi.errorPexelsKey: A Pexels API key is missing on the server. Add PEXELS_API_KEY, then retry.
StudioAi.errorDelete: Could not delete the task (it may still be running).
StudioAi.tasksLead: Each job runs on the Python engine beside the site.

Pricing.metaDescription: Free and Plus plans for creating ayah media on Arabya
Pricing.title: Plans
Pricing.lead: Mushaf reading and word study stay free for everyone. Plus unlocks creation tools. PayPal checkout comes after these features are stable.
Pricing.plus2: Recitation MP4 export in the browser
Pricing.plus3: Priority for future licensed study extras
Pricing.paypalSoon: Payment gateway: PayPal — coming after this create suite ships. Until then, Plus is granted via admin / ARABYA_PLUS_EMAILS (editors and admins are Plus for testing).
Pricing.manualUpgrade: Ask an admin to add your email to ARABYA_PLUS_EMAILS, or use an editor/admin account while testing.
